content_html:
Prime Bun: A Bun-Native RLM Agent

Documentation • Verifiers • PRIME-RL • pi-mono

Bun-native by design

Prime Bun replaces the Python notebook with a native Bun implementation. RLM programs execute as persistent JavaScript or TypeScript directly in Bun—not through a Python wrapper or subprocess bridge—with retained session state, prepared runtime globals, native shell execution, abort and recovery handling, and snapshot support.

Lower is better. Bun faster is the reduction in elapsed time relative to the Python implementation.

Operation Bun Python Bun faster
Startup 57.8 ms 789.4 ms 92.7%
Scalar cell 2.07 ms 2.96 ms 30.1%
64 KiB output 1.77 ms 3.10 ms 42.9%
10,000 writes 3.20 ms 14.98 ms 78.6%
Native shell 1.38 ms 9.13 ms 84.9%
Abort 146.5 ms 175.7 ms 16.6%
Recovery 2.55 ms 3.30 ms 22.7%
32 MiB snapshot 23.31 ms 38.31 ms 39.2%

Note

Prime Bun is a fork of Prime Agent. All credit for the original agent, RLM architecture, TUI, and surrounding ecosystem goes to Prime Intellect and the Prime Agent contributors. Their thoughtful and ambitious work created an exceptional open-source foundation; this fork focuses on a Bun-native JavaScript and TypeScript runtime.

Prime Bun builds on Prime Agent, an open-source coding and research agent for general and long-running work. It preserves two core abstractions:

  • The Recursive Language Model (RLM) treats context as variables (prompt-as-a-variable) and tools like recursive subagents as function calls (programmatic tool /sub-agent calling) inside a persistent REPL.
  • The Continual Harness stores supplemental prompts, memories, skill descriptions, and reusable subagent specifications as durable state that Prime Bun can refine through small, evidence-backed updates, local to the session by default.

Prime Bun combines a persistent Bun JavaScript control environment with durable harness state, so useful working context and reusable operating patterns can outlive a single chat window.

  • Everything is programmatic: the persistent Bun notebook is the built-in model tool; file operations, shell commands, skill use, subagents, and context management happen through JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Subagents are built in: rlm(...) spawns real child agents for parallel or background work and returns an admission handle; results arrive through explicit agent messages or files.
  • The harness can improve: /refine reviews the current trajectory and can apply small, evidence-backed updates to supplemental harness state. It never rewrites the immutable base system prompt, and recorded snapshots support rollback.
  • Skills are executable: JavaScript-backed skills load prepared globals into the notebook, and the built-in skill creator can turn recurring workflows into project or personal skills.
  • Sessions run in the background: daemon-backed agents keep running when the terminal disconnects and can be reattached later.
  • Agents communicate directly: running agents can exchange messages and orchestrate one another without routing everything through the user.
  • Long tasks keep moving: automatic compaction, persistent goals, heartbeats, schedules, autonomous mode, and retained subagents preserve progress across turns and terminal sessions.

Getting Started

Install the local checkout with Node.js 22.8 or newer:

git clone https://github.com/sng-asyncfunc/prime-bun.git
cd prime-bun
npm ci
npm link

npm link exposes the checkout as the prime-bun command. Run it from the repository or directory you want Prime Bun to work in:

cd /path/to/project
prime-bun

On first launch, run /login to choose a subscription or API-key provider. Prime Bun works in the current directory and can run commands and modify files there. Use a disposable clone, clean worktree, or another checkpoint you can inspect and restore.

Warning

Prime Bun executes model-generated JavaScript, TypeScript, and project commands with your user permissions. Its worker and notebook processes improve lifecycle isolation and recovery; they are not a security sandbox. Review changes and use trusted repositories, instructions, skills, and extensions only. Run untrusted code or instructions in an external sandbox or restricted environment.

Useful commands:

prime-bun agents                   # Browse running, idle, and saved sessions
prime-bun attach <agent>           # Reattach to a running session
prime-bun --resume <path|id>       # Resume a saved session
prime-bun status                   # Inspect background service state
prime-bun doctor [--fix]           # Inspect or repair background services
prime-bun shutdown [--force]       # Stop every agent, worker, and background service

Built for Long-Running Work

Prime Bun is built for long-running work, especially for evaluations in research. These features are available in the TUI and when run autonomously.

  • Continual Harness: /refine can persist focused, reviewable lessons as supplemental prompts, memories, reusable skill descriptions, or subagent specifications, with recorded refinement history. It does not replace packaging and reviewing new executable skills.
  • Direct agent-to-agent communication: running agents and retained subagents can discover one another, exchange messages, and steer active work.
  • Daemon-backed continuity: active sessions, Bun notebook state, schedules, and subagents keep running when the terminal detaches and can be reattached later.
  • Heartbeats and schedules: /heartbeat, rlmHeartbeat, and prime-bun schedule can re-enter a session periodically or at a specific time.
  • Persistent goals: /goal keeps an objective and its progress active across turns until it is completed, paused, or cleared.
  • Bounded autonomous mode: /autonomous continues within configured turn, token, and time budgets and can run user-defined quality gates. A passed gate checks only what that gate verifies; reaching a limit does not imply task success.

Documentation

  • Quickstart — install, authenticate, and run a first session
  • Usage and CLI reference — commands, sessions, autonomous limits, and output modes
  • Long-running and background agents — detach and reattach, goals, heartbeats, and schedules
  • RLM programming model — persistent Bun execution, subagents, skills, and the trust model
  • JSON mode and RPC mode — headless automation and integrations
  • Skills — install and create reusable capabilities
  • Provider setup — subscription and API-key providers
  • Architecture overview — daemon, worker, notebook, and persistence boundaries
  • Development — build and run from source

Acknowledgements

Our agent and TUI is built on top of pi. We thank the authors of pi for their valuable work.

License

Prime Bun is fully open source and released under the MIT License.

Disclaimer

I am not claiming JavaScript wins every RLM race. If you are building data pipelines, running heavy numerical analysis, or using the classic scientific stack, Prime Agent's native IPython setup is exactly what you need.

But the future of coding agents isn't strictly data science. It is web infrastructure, edge deployments, and massive TypeScript monorepos. Prime Agent is an incredible leap forward for autonomous coding. But if you are building for the web, do yourself a favor: kill the Python kernel and run it in Bun.

content_html_zh:
Prime Bun：Bun 本地 RLM 代理

文档 • 验证者 • PRIME-RL • pi-mono

Bun 原生设计

Prime Bun 用本机 Bun 实现替换了 Python 笔记本。 RLM 程序直接在 Bun 中作为持久 JavaScript 或 TypeScript 执行（而不是通过 Python 包装器或子进程桥），并保留会话状态、准备好的运行时全局变量、本机 shell 执行、中止和恢复处理以及快照支持。

越低越好。 Bun 更快是相对于 Python 实现而言所用时间的减少。

手术 Bun Python 包子更快
启动 57.8 ms 789.4 ms 92.7%
标量单元 2.07 ms 2.96 ms 30.1%
64 KiB 输出 1.77 ms 3.10 ms 42.9%
10,000 次写入 3.20 ms 14.98 ms 78.6%
原生外壳 1.38 ms 9.13 ms 84.9%
Abort 146.5 ms 175.7 ms 16.6%
恢复 2.55 ms 3.30 ms 22.7%
32 MiB 快照 23.31 ms 38.31 ms 39.2%

Note

Prime Bun 是 Prime Agent 的一个分支。 原始代理、RLM 架构、TUI 和周围生态系统的所有功劳都归于 Prime Intellect 和 Prime Agent 贡献者。 他们深思熟虑且雄心勃勃的工作创造了卓越的开源基础；该分支专注于 Bun 原生 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 运行时。

Prime Bun 建立在 Prime Agent 的基础上，Prime Agent 是一个用于一般和长期运行工作的开源编码和研究代理。 它保留了两个核心抽象：

  • 递归语言模型 (RLM) 将上下文视为变量（提示作为变量），将递归子代理等工具视为持久 REPL 内的函数调用（编程工具/子代理调用）。
  • 连续线束将补充提示、记忆、技能描述和可重复使用的子代理规范存储为持久状态，Prime Bun 可以通过默认情况下在会话本地进行的小型、有证据支持的更新进行改进。

Prime Bun 将持久的 Bun JavaScript 控制环境与持久的线束状态相结合，因此有用的工作上下文和可重用的操作模式可以比单个聊天窗口更长久。

  • 一切都是程序化的：持久的 Bun 笔记本是内置的模型工具；文件操作、shell 命令、技能使用、子代理和上下文管理通过 JavaScript 或 TypeScript 进行。
  • 子代理内置于：rlm(...) 生成真正的子代理以进行并行或后台工作并返回准入句柄；结果通过显式代理消息或文件到达。
  • 线束可以改进： /refine 审查当前轨迹，并可以对补充线束状态应用小的、有证据支持的更新。 它永远不会重写不可变的基础系统提示，并且记录的快照支持回滚。
  • 技能是可执行的：JavaScript 支持的技能将准备好的全局变量加载到笔记本中，内置技能创建器可以将重复的工作流程转换为项目或个人技能。
  • 会话在后台运行：当终端断开连接时，守护程序支持的代理将继续运行，并且可以稍后重新连接。
  • 代理直接通信：运行中的代理可以交换消息并相互协调，而无需通过用户路由所有内容。
  • 长任务不断移动：自动压缩、持久目标、心跳、时间表、自主模式和保留的子代理可以保持轮流和终端会话的进度。

入门

使用 Node.js 22.8 或更高版本安装本地结账：

git clone https://github.com/sng-asyncfunc/prime-bun.git
cd prime-bun
npm ci
npm link

npm 链接将结帐公开为 prime-bun 命令。 从您希望 Prime Bun 工作的存储库或目录运行它：

cd /path/to/project
prime-bun

首次启动时，运行 /login 以选择订阅或 API 密钥提供商。 Prime Bun 在当前目录中工作，可以在那里运行命令和修改文件。 使用一次性克隆、干净的工作树或其他可以检查和恢复的检查点。

警告

Prime Bun 使用您的用户权限执行模型生成的 JavaScript、TypeScript 和项目命令。 它的工作进程和笔记本进程改进了生命周期隔离和恢复；它们不是安全沙箱。 仅查看更改并使用受信任的存储库、说明、技能和扩展。 在外部沙箱或受限环境中运行不受信任的代码或指令。

有用的命令：

prime-bun agents                   # Browse running, idle, and saved sessions
prime-bun attach <agent>           # Reattach to a running session
prime-bun --resume <path|id>       # Resume a saved session
prime-bun status                   # Inspect background service state
prime-bun doctor [--fix]           # Inspect or repair background services
prime-bun shutdown [--force]       # Stop every agent, worker, and background service

专为长时间运行的工作而打造

Prime Bun 专为长期运行的工作而设计，尤其是研究评估。 这些功能在 TUI 中以及自主运行时可用。

  • 持续利用：/refine 可以将重点突出、可复习的课程作为补充提示、记忆、可重复使用的技能描述或子代理规范，并记录细化历史记录。 它不会取代打包和审查新的可执行技能。
  • 代理之间的直接通信：正在运行的代理和保留的子代理可以相互发现、交换消息并引导主动工作。
  • 守护程序支持的连续性：活动会话、Bun 笔记本状态、计划和子代理在终端分离时保持运行，并且可以稍后重新连接。
  • 心跳和时间表：/heartbeat、rlmHeartbeat 和 prime-bun 时间表可以定期或在特定时间重新进入会话。
  • 持久目标：/goal 使目标及其进度在回合中保持活跃，直到完成、暂停或清除。
  • 有界自治模式：/autonomous 在配置的轮次、令牌和时间预算内继续，并且可以运行用户定义的质量门。 通过的门仅检查该门验证的内容；达到极限并不意味着任务成功。

执照

Prime Bun 是完全开源的，并根据 MIT 许可证发布。

免责声明

我并不是说 JavaScript 赢得了每场 RLM 竞赛。 如果您正在构建数据管道、运行繁重的数值分析或使用经典的科学堆栈，那么 Prime Agent 的本机 IPython 设置正是您所需要的。

但编码代理的未来并不是严格意义上的数据科学。 它是 Web 基础设施、边缘部署和大规模 TypeScript monorepos。 Prime Agent 是自主编码方面令人难以置信的飞跃。 但如果您正在为 Web 进行构建，请帮自己一个忙：杀死 Python 内核并在 Bun 中运行它。
